 Heavy rainfall expected: Yellow alert issued for Karnataka's coastal, Malnad regions until November 6
 Vartha Bharati 4 Nov 2026 11:52 PM IST share Representational Image
 Bengaluru: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast rainfall across several parts of Karnataka over the next two days, with yellow alerts issued for the coastal region on November 4 and for Malnad districts and South Interior Karnataka until November 6.
 According to the Meteorological Department, isolated parts of Coastal Karnataka are likely to receive rain accompanied by thunder and lightning on November 5.
 South Interior Karnataka is expected to experience light to moderate rainfall, along with thunder and lightning, at isolated places until November 6. There is also a possibility of heavy rainfall in isolated parts of the region.
 The department has also forecast light to moderate rain accompanied by thunder, lightning and strong winds at isolated places across the coastal, Malnad and South Interior regions.
 Meanwhile, parts of the state are likely to witness a mix of sunny and cloudy weather. Rainfall activity is expected to remain relatively low in North Interior Karnataka.
